execution_method: Install the packed package as a community node, import a published workflow (Arcmira Trigger polling every minute, then the Arcmira node searching transcripts), and run n8n start. The trigger's stored record was seeded with every delivered alert of a live monitor except the newest one.
network: Live api.arcmira.com with a test account key
live_api_requests: GET /v1/monitors/{id}/alerts per poll, one GET /v1/search per execution

checks.case: first poll in trigger mode emits only the alert missing from the record
the Arcmira node runs after the trigger and returns passages with watch links
the record stores the emitted alert first

limits: Does not verify the browser editor, Fetch Test Event in the editor, n8n Cloud or Creator Portal review.
Does not verify npm publication or provenance.
The live monitor had no alert that was still sending, held back or failed during the run; those cases are covered by the trigger tests in n8n's polling context.
